name: com.gameframex.unity.coroutine
description:
GameFrameX Coroutine — Unity centralized coroutine management package. Provides centralized start/stop control with thread-safe tracking (ConcurrentDictionary keyed by enumerator reference), bulk StopAllCoroutines that also covers untracked coroutines, and WaitForEndOfFrame callback helpers for frame-precise execution. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Coroutine — Unity 协程集中管理功能包。提供协程的集中启动/停止控制，基于枚举器引用键的 ConcurrentDictionary 线程安全追踪，StopAllCoroutines 批量停止（同时覆盖未跟踪协程），以及 WaitForEndOfFrame 回调辅助实现帧精确执行。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
